# IfcOpenShell / IfcConvert

FireCAE distributes the standalone Windows `IfcConvert.exe` from the
IfcOpenShell 0.8.2 release package. The executable reports IfcOpenShell 0.8.0
with OpenCascade 7.8.1 and is used only as an out-of-process IFC conversion
worker.

- Project: https://github.com/IfcOpenShell/IfcOpenShell
- Binary package: https://github.com/IfcOpenShell/IfcOpenShell/releases/tag/ifcconvert-0.8.2
- License: LGPL-3.0-or-later; see `COPYING` and `COPYING.LESSER`

The executable is distributed unmodified.
